prompt:
A pixel-crisp, full-fidelity desktop web UI design comp of the Mars Bank online banking dashboard, rendered as a flat 1440x900 browser viewport screenshot with no device frame, no browser chrome, no drop shadow, no perspective, no mockup background — the interface fills the entire canvas edge to edge.

DIRECTION: "Quiet Account Workspace" — one centered account sheet carries the daily banking task, while navigation recedes into a slim graphite rail. Far lighter, calmer and much less dense than the reference dark comp. Generous white space, hairline dividers, no cards-within-cards, no shadows, no rounded panels beyond 2px.

PALETTE, used exactly: page canvas soft mineral off-white #F4F5F3; the account sheet paper-white #FFFFFF; all ink and the left rail graphite #101518; one oxide accent #E4623F for the single primary action and account reference numerals; coordinate blue #356CFF for plotted balances and the available total. No other hues. No gradients except an almost imperceptible mineral tone in the canvas.

TYPOGRAPHY: a calm, soft humanist grotesk very similar to Hanken Grotesk — generous round counters, never condensed, never all-caps except the tiniest 10-11px column labels with light letterspacing. Sentence case everywhere else. Numerals are tabular and lining.

REGIONS, top to bottom:
1. Far left, a slim 72px-wide full-height vertical rail in solid graphite #101518. At its top a small 24px circular orbital-arc mark: a thin ellipse ring with a tiny oxide #E4623F node dot. Below it four stacked 1.5px-stroke line icons, each centered with a 9px sentence-case caption beneath in pale grey: a four-square grid labeled Overview (active, marked only by a short 2px oxide vertical tick on the rail's inner edge and brighter white icon), a classical bank building labeled Accounts, a credit card outline labeled Cards, and two opposed arrows labeled Transfer. At the very bottom of the rail a 28px circle avatar in white with graphite initials CV.
2. A compact 52px utility bar spanning the remaining width on the #F4F5F3 canvas, separated from the content by a single hairline #E4E6E3 rule. Left: small sentence-case text "Primary account set" with a tiny chevron. Right: three small 12px grey text actions with minimal line icons — Security, Support, Log out.
3. A generous heading block with large breathing room: a 34px graphite sentence-case greeting "Good evening, Cameron", and beneath it in 13px muted grey "Mars Sol 21". Aligned right on the same baseline, a small 11px uppercase label "Available total" and beneath it a restrained 40px coordinate-blue #356CFF tabular figure "2,561,980" followed by a small 12px grey unit "model tokens". To its right a single oxide #E4623F filled rectangular button, square corners, 44px tall, white sentence-case label "Make a transfer" with a thin right arrow.
4. THE DOMINANT ELEMENT: one wide centered paper-white #FFFFFF account sheet occupying most of the viewport, square corners, one 1px #E7E9E6 outline and absolutely no shadow. Inside, a 12px uppercase letterspaced column header row in muted grey — Account, Branch and number, Available (MT), Held (MT), Total (MT) — under a hairline rule. Then four tall, airy account rows separated by single hairline #EFF0EE rules, each row about 76px tall with a small oxide #E4623F two-digit reference numeral at the far left:
   01 — "Everyday", small grey subtitle "Spend · Daily access", branch "Olympus Mons Branch · OMS-1001-0001", available "184,220" in coordinate blue, held "2,180", total "186,400" in graphite.
   02 — "Crater Reserve", subtitle "Savings · Long term", "Valles Marineris Branch · VMB-2001-0002", available "1,840,000" in coordinate blue, held "0", total "1,840,000".
   03 — "Habitat Offset", subtitle "Sustainability · Projects", "Cydonia Branch · CYD-3001-0003", available "620,400", held "4,600", total "625,000".
   04 — "Mars Bank Credit", subtitle "Revolving · Credit", "Olympus Mons Branch · OMS-4001-0004", available shown as a muted en dash, held en dash, and at the right a small 11px grey label "Owed" above the graphite figure "82,640".
   Each row ends with a faint 14px grey chevron at the far right edge.
5. A narrow footer strip beneath the sheet, low-contrast and secondary: a 11px uppercase label "Recent movement" at left and a small blue text link "View all" at right, with four compact single-line entries laid out horizontally across the strip, each with a tiny grey sol stamp, a sentence-case merchant name, and a right-aligned amount — "Sol 21 · Areology Coffee −2,450", "Sol 21 · Mars Research Collective +25,000" in coordinate blue, "Sol 21 · Valles Transit −1,820", "Sol 20 · Habitat Utilities −6,340". Debits in graphite, the credit in coordinate blue. Divided by faint vertical hairlines only.

No marketing copy, no invented rates, awards, dates or promotional claims. No photographs, no illustration, no charts, no logos other than the small orbital mark. Realistic UI rendering with crisp 1px rules, accurate small-text legibility, perfectly aligned baselines and grids.
